name: application-inventory-level-row
title: Inventory Level Row
description: A SKU-level stock indicator with an in-stock proportion bar, a reorder-threshold marker, and a low-stock warning badge, at both single-row detail and multi-row list scale.
useWhen: Displaying a product's current stock level relative to its reorder threshold in an inventory or warehouse management interface.
Scanning a list of SKUs to spot which ones are healthy, low, or out of stock at a glance.
avoidWhen: The metric is a billing/plan quota rather than physical stock — use usage-meter instead, since the reorder-threshold framing is inventory-specific.
You need per-unit transaction history rather than a current-level snapshot — a table or transaction row is more appropriate.
responsiveBehavior: The detail row expands to fill its container; the list variant uses a fixed-width label column with a flexible bar so many rows stay vertically aligned regardless of product name length (names truncate with an ellipsis).
accessibility: The reorder-threshold marker is a decorative (aria-hidden) dashed line reinforced by the 'Reorder at N' text below the bar, so the threshold is never conveyed by position alone.
The low-stock warning badge pairs an icon with explicit text ('Below reorder point'), not color or icon alone.
Exact unit counts are always shown as text alongside the proportional bar, giving precise values independent of the visual fill.

variants.title: Detail row
variants.description: Single SKU with a stock bar, dashed reorder-threshold marker, and a below-reorder-point warning badge
accessibility: The warning badge pairs an icon with explicit text, and the threshold marker is reinforced by a text label.

variants.description: Single SKU with a stock bar, dashed reorder-threshold marker, and a below-reorder-point warning badge
